name: amr-clonalshare
summary: Measures how much of an antimicrobial resistance phenotype travels with the lineages of a bacterial collection: a realised and a superpopulation share with measured intervals and gates that refuse where the collection cannot support an estimate, an anytime-valid e-value per agent, a Kitagawa decomposition of a prevalence difference into lineage mix and within-lineage rate, an interval-censored reading of MIC panels, and fail-closed diagnostics for multi-layer trait clustering.
